akatsuki.prompt: Production texture asset for a Japanese fantasy Minecraft sword inventory backdrop. ONE square image with transparent exterior, centered DIAMOND silhouette, flat straight-on orthographic. Inside diamond: black oxblood lacquer, one weathered crimson crescent moon in upper-left, faint trailing red brush mist, sparse aged gold flecks. Hand-painted Japanese maki-e lacquer meets restrained sumi-e ink wash, sophisticated tactile brushwork and fine material detail. IMPORTANT restrained composition: about 65% calm dark negative space, one dominant motif occupying upper quarter, secondary marks faint and sparse, central diagonal corridor quiet so a sword rendered over it stays readable. Medium visual richness, not a flat vector icon. No ornate borders, no metallic decorative frame, no baroque filigree, no full-scene painting, no flower bouquets, no character, no weapon, no text, no interface mockup. All opaque content INSIDE an inset diamond whose four tips lie at 9%,50%;50%,9%;91%,50%;50%,91%. Outside diamond truly transparent. Rich local brush shading, elegant collectible weapon backdrop, readable at 32-pixel display size.
